newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-QUINN OUT OF IRELAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-QUINN OUT OF IRELAND SQUAD.

text.p: Striker Niall Quinn on Tuesday withdrew from the Ireland squad for next week's World Cup qualifier against Liechtenstein because he needs a cartilage operation.
Quinn, 30, said he would enter hospital later this week for the operation, which rules him out of the European group eight clash at Lansdowne Road on May 21.

The Sunderland striker was recalled to the international squad four days ago, having missed Ireland's last five matches and five months of the English premier league season with a damaged cruciate ligament.
